<!-- Generated by ModuleDocsGenerator from the annotations of org.hortonmachine.modules.SplitSubbasins: do not edit, change the annotations and regenerate. -->

Splits a basin into the subbasins of the streams up to a Hack order: with order 2, the subbasins of the streams of order 1 and 2, and their network, are extracted and numbered.

**Toolbox folder:** Dem Manipulation<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** Subbasins, Hack order, Network<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.SplitSubbasins`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inFlow` | raster file |  |  | The map of the drainage directions. |
| `inHack` | raster file |  |  | The map of the Hack orders of the network, as computed by the NetworkAttributesBuilder module. |
| `pHackorder` | Double |  |  | The highest Hack order of the streams whose subbasins are extracted. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outNetnum` | output file |  | The map of the numbered network. |
| `outSubbasins` | output file |  | The map of the subbasins, with the number of their stream. |
